title: erysimum serpillifolium
intro: Erysimum serpillifolium, commonly known as woolly locoweed, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of woolly locoweed include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects. The therapeutic actions of Erysimum serpillifolium include pain relief, wound healing, and the alleviation of symptoms associated with respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders.
